text_en: while Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
text_cn: 耶稣上了橄榄山。

text_en: Early in the morning he came again to the temple. All the people came to him and he sat down and began to teach them.
text_cn: 清晨他又来到圣殿，众百姓都到他跟前来，他便坐下教训他们。

text_en: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery; and making her stand before all of them,
text_cn: 那时，经师和法利塞人带来了一个犯奸淫时被捉住的妇人，叫她站在中间，

text_en: they said to him, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act of committing adultery.
text_cn: 便向耶稣说：“师傅！这妇人是正在犯奸淫时被捉住的，

text_en: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say? ”
text_cn: 在法律上，梅瑟命令我们该用石头砸死这样的妇人；可是，你说什么呢？”

text_en: They said this to test him, so that they might have some charge to bring against him. Jesus bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground.
text_cn: 他们说这话，是要试探耶稣，好能控告他；耶稣却弯下身去，用指头在地上画字。

text_en: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, “Let anyone among you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her. ”
text_cn: 因为他们不断地追问，他便直起身来，向他们说：“你们中间谁没有罪，先向她投石罢！”

text_en: And once again he bent down and wrote on the ground.
text_cn: 他又弯下身去，在地上写字。

text_en: When they heard it, they went away, one by one, beginning with the elders; and Jesus was left alone with the woman standing before him.
text_cn: 他们一听这话，就从年老的开始到年幼的，一个一个地都溜走了，只留下耶稣一人和站在那里的妇人。

text_en: Jesus straightened up and said to her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you? ”
text_cn: 耶稣遂直起身来向她说：“妇人！他们在哪里呢？没有人定你的罪吗？”

text_en: She said, “No one, sir. ” And Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way, and from now on do not sin again. ”]]
text_cn: 她说：“主！没有人。”耶稣向她说：“我也不定你的罪；去罢！从今以后，不要再犯罪了！”

text_en: Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness but will have the light of life. ”
text_cn: 耶稣又向众人讲说：“我是世界的光；跟随我的，决不在黑暗中行走，必有生命的光。”

text_en: Then the Pharisees said to him, “You are testifying on your own behalf; your testimony is not valid. ”
text_cn: 法利塞人于是对他说：“你为你自己作证，你的证据，是不可凭信的。”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid because I know where I have come from and where I am going, but you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我即便为我自己作证，我的证据，是可凭信的，因为我知道：我从哪里来，往哪里去；你们却不知道：我从哪里来，或往哪里去。

text_en: You judge by human standards; I judge no one.
text_cn: 你们只凭肉眼判断，我却不判断任何人；

text_en: Yet even if I do judge, my judgment is valid; for it is not I alone who judge, but I and the Father who sent me.
text_cn: 即使我判断，我的判断，仍是真实的，因为我不是独自一个，而是有我，还有派遣我来的父。

text_en: In your law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is valid.
text_cn: 在你们的法律上也记载着：两个人的作证，是可凭信的。

text_en: I testify on my own behalf, and the Father who sent me testifies on my behalf. ”
text_cn: 今有我为我自己作证，也有派遣我的父，为我作证。”

text_en: Then they said to him, “Where is your Father? ” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also. ”
text_cn: 他们便问他说：“你的父在哪里？”耶稣答复说：“你们不认识我，也不认识我的父；若是你们认识了我，也就认识我的父了。”

text_en: He spoke these words while he was teaching in the treasury of the temple, but no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
text_cn: 这些话是耶稣于圣殿施教时，在银库院里所讲的。谁也没有捉拿他，因为他的时辰还没有到。

text_en: Again he said to them, “I am going away, and you will search for me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come. ”
text_cn: 那时，耶稣又向他们说：“我去了，你们要寻找我，你们必要死在你们的罪恶中；我所去的地方，你们不能去。”

text_en: Then the Jews said, “Is he going to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’? ”
text_cn: 犹太人便说：“他说：我所去的地方，你们不能去；莫非他要自杀吗？”

text_en: He said to them, “You are from below, I am from above; you are of this world, I am not of this world.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“你们是出于下，我却是出于上；你们是出于这个世界，我却不是出于这个世界。

text_en: I told you that you would die in your sins, for you will die in your sins unless you believe that I am he. ”
text_cn: 因此，我对你们说过：你们要死在你们的罪恶中。的确，你们若不相信我就是那一位，你们必要死在你们的罪恶中。”

text_en: They said to him, “Who are you? ” Jesus said to them, “Why do I speak to you at all?
text_cn: 于是，他们问耶稣说：“你到底是谁？”耶稣回答他们说：“难道从起初我没有对你们讲论过吗？

text_en: I have much to say about you and much to condemn; but the one who sent me is true, and I declare to the world what I have heard from him. ”
text_cn: 对你们我有许多事要说，要谴责；但是派遣我来者是真实的；我由他听来的，我就讲给世界听。”

text_en: They did not understand that he was speaking to them about the Father.
text_cn: 他们不明白他是在给他们讲论父。

text_en: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will realize that I am he, and that I do nothing on my own, but I speak these things as the Father instructed me.
text_cn: 耶稣遂说：“当你们高举了人子以后，你们便知道我就是那一位。我由我自己不作什么；我所讲论的，都是依照父所教训我的。

text_en: And the one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what is pleasing to him. ”
text_cn: 派遣我来者与我在一起，他没有留下我独自一个，因为我常作他所喜悦的事。”

text_en: As he was saying these things, many believed in him.
text_cn: 当耶稣讲这些话时，许多人便信了他。

text_en: Then Jesus said to the Jews who had believed in him, “If you continue in my word, you are truly my disciples;
text_cn: 于是，耶稣对那些信他的犹太人说：“你们如果固守我的话，就确是我的门徒，

text_en: and you will know the truth, and the truth will make you free. ”
text_cn: 也会认识真理，而真理必会使你们获得自由。”

text_en: They answered him, “We are descendants of Abraham and have never been slaves to anyone. What do you mean by saying, ‘You will be made free’? ”
text_cn: 他们回答说：“我们是亚巴郎的后裔，从未给任何人做过奴隶；怎么你说：你们要成为自由的呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “Very truly, I tell you, everyone who commits sin is a slave to sin.
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“我实实在在告诉你们：凡是犯罪的，就是罪恶的奴隶。

text_en: The slave does not have a permanent place in the household; the son has a place there forever.
text_cn: 奴隶不能永远住在家里，儿子却永远居住。

text_en: So if the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
text_cn: 那么，如果天主子使你们自由了，你们的确是自由的。

text_en: I know that you are descendants of Abraham; yet you look for an opportunity to kill me, because there is no place in you for my word.
text_cn: 我知道你们是亚巴郎的后裔，你们却图谋杀害我，因为你们容纳不下我的话。

text_en: I declare what I have seen in the Father’s presence; as for you, you should do what you have heard from the Father. ”
text_cn: 我说的，是我在父那里所看见的；而你们行的，却是从你们的父亲那里所学习的。”

text_en: They answered him, “Abraham is our father. ” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would be doing what Abraham did,
text_cn: 他们回答说：“我们的父亲是亚巴郎。”耶稣对他们说：“假如你们是亚巴郎的子女，你们就该作亚巴郎所作的事。

text_en: but now you are trying to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. This is not what Abraham did.
text_cn: 如今，你们竟然图谋杀害我──这个给你们说出从天主那里所听到的真理的人──亚巴郎却没有作过这样的事。

text_en: You are indeed doing what your father does. ” They said to him, “We are not illegitimate children; we have one father, God himself. ”
text_cn: 你们正作你们父亲的事业。”他们向他说：“我们不是由淫乱生的，我们只有一个父亲：就是天主。”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and now I am here. I did not come on my own, but he sent me.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“假如天主是你们的父亲，你们必爱我，因为我是由天主出发而来的，并不是由我自己来的，而是那一位派遣了我。

text_en: Why do you not understand what I say? It is because you cannot accept my word.
text_cn: 为什么你们不明白我的讲论呢？无非是你们不肯听我的话。

text_en: You are from your father the devil, and you choose to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks according to his own nature, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
text_cn: 你们是出于你们的父亲魔鬼，并愿意追随你们父亲的欲望。从起初，他就是杀人的凶手，不站在真理上，因为在他内没有真理；他几时撒谎，正出于他的本性，因为他是撒谎者，而且又是撒谎者的父亲。

text_en: But because I tell the truth, you do not believe me.
text_cn: 至于我，因为我说真理，你们却不信我。

text_en: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
text_cn: 你们中谁能指证我有罪？若是我说真理，为什么你们却不信我呢？

text_en: Whoever is from God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear them is that you are not from God. ”
text_cn: 出于天主的，必听天主的话；你们所以不听，因为你们不是出于天主。”

text_en: The Jews answered him, “Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon? ”
text_cn: 犹太人遂向他说：“我们说你是个撒玛黎雅人，并附有魔鬼，岂不正对吗？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “I do not have a demon; but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“我没有附魔，我只是尊敬我的父，你们却侮辱我。

text_en: Yet I do not seek my own glory; there is one who seeks it and he is the judge.
text_cn: 然而，我不寻求我的光荣，有为我寻求而行判断的一位。

text_en: Very truly, I tell you, whoever keeps my word will never see death. ”
text_cn: 我实实在在告诉你们：谁如果遵行我的话，永远见不到死亡。”

text_en: The Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and so did the prophets; yet you say, ‘Whoever keeps my word will never taste death. ’
text_cn: 犹太人向他说：“现在我们知道：你附有魔鬼；亚巴郎和先知都死了；你却说：谁如果遵行我的话，永远尝不到死味。

text_en: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets also died. Who do you claim to be? ”
text_cn: 难道你比我们的父亲亚巴郎还大吗？他死了，先知们也死了。你把你自己当作什么人呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, he of whom you say, ‘He is our God, ’
text_cn: 耶稣答复说：“我如果光荣我自己，我的光荣算不了什么；那光荣我的，是我的父，就是你们所称的“我们的天主。”

text_en: though you do not know him. But I know him; if I would say that I do not know him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know him and I keep his word.
text_cn: 你们不认识他，我却认识他；我若说我不认识他，我便像你们一样是个撒谎者；但是，我认识他，也遵守他的话。

text_en: Your ancestor Abraham rejoiced that he would see my day; he saw it and was glad. ”
text_cn: 你们的父亲亚巴郎曾欢欣喜乐地企望看到我的日子，他看见了，极其高兴。”

text_en: Then the Jews said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham? ”
text_cn: 犹太人就对他说：“你还没有五十岁，就见过亚巴郎吗？”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “Very truly, I tell you, before Abraham was, I am. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我实实在在告诉你们：在亚巴郎出现以前，我就有。”

text_en: So they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple.
text_cn: 他们就拿起石头来要向他投去；耶稣却隐没了，从圣殿里出去了。
